case_name: Smt. Rinki Idnani vs Nitin Idnani
facts_of_case: Petitioner/wife and respondent/husband were married on 26.06.2010. The husband filed a petition for decree of divorce alleging continuous acts of cruelty. The wife filed an application under Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 seeking interim maintenance.

legal_principles.principle: The object of maintenance is to prevent vagrancy and destitution.
legal_principles.held: It provides a speedy remedy for the supply of food, clothing and shelter to the deserted wife.

legal_principles.principle: The court may order the respondent to pay expenses of proceeding and monthly maintenance during the proceeding.
legal_principles.held: It may, on the application of the wife or the husband, order the respondent to pay to the petitioner the expenses of the proceeding, and monthly during the proceeding such sum as, having regard to the petitioner's own income and the income of the respondent, it may seem to the court to be reasonable.

outcome.final_order: The order dated 04.03.2023 passed by the Additional Principal Judge, Family Court Indore may kindly be modified and the maintenance as prayed in the application may kindly be ordered to be passed.
